# Template gallery

The templates that come with Tyto: 3, in 6 formats. They are there to try Tyto and to test it with. The templates a team publishes with live in their own repositories, and a plugin file names them so Tyto fetches them: [Fetch templates from their own repositories](../command-line/plugins.md#fetch-templates-from-their-own-repositories) shows how. Each picture is the template drawing the example brief kept beside it, in the first format it lists, drawn without a brand kit: a plain shape stands where a brand's logo goes and `@assinatura` where its signature goes. A brief names one of these in its `template:` line and fills the slots listed under it. The descriptions are written in the templates themselves, in English.

## Formats

The sizes a brief can ask for in its `formats:` line. A template draws only the formats it lists. [Formats](../briefs/formats.md) explains the names.

| Id | Size | Kind | Label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `grid` | 1080 × 1350 | `grid` | Grid |
| `grid-1x1` | 1080 × 1080 | `grid` | Grid 1:1 |
| `story` | 1080 × 1920 | `story` | Story |
| `banner` | 1200 × 628 | `banner` | Banner |
| `banner-1x1` | 600 × 600 | `banner` | Banner 1:1 |
| `banner-345x146` | 345 × 146 | `banner` | Banner 345×146 |

## banner-roxo

![banner-roxo, drawing examples/agencia.brief in the banner format](/template-gallery/banner-roxo.png)

roxo's product banner — one text over a fixed background, in three sizes.

**Brand** `roxo` · **Makes** banner · **Formats** `banner` (1200 × 628), `banner-1x1` (600 × 600), `banner-345x146` (345 × 146)

**Slots**

| Slot | Type |  | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `titulo` | `rich-text` | required | text; at most 120 characters |

## carrossel-lista

![carrossel-lista, drawing examples/lista.brief in the grid-1x1 format](/template-gallery/carrossel-lista.png)

A list carousel — the list's title on every slide, one item to a slide.

**Brand** `tyto-demo` · **Makes** carrossel, stories · **Formats** `grid-1x1` (1080 × 1080), `story` (1080 × 1920)

**Slots**

| Slot | Type |  | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `titulo` | `rich-text` | required | text; at most 60 characters |
| `lamina` | `rich-text` | optional | text; repeats: one artwork each; at least 1; at most 10 |
| `tom` | `enum` | optional | one of `claro`, `escuro` (default `escuro`) |

**Adjustments** — Written in braces after a directive, on the slots named here.

| Adjustment | Type | On | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `destaque` | `flag` | `lamina` | on or off |
| `tom` | `enum` | `lamina` | one of `claro`, `escuro` |

## promo-curso

![promo-curso, drawing examples/promo.brief in the grid-1x1 format](/template-gallery/promo-curso.png)

Course promotion with a teacher photo, a headline and a colour variant.

**Brand** `tyto-demo` · **Makes** grid, story · **Formats** `grid-1x1` (1080 × 1080), `story` (1080 × 1920)

**Slots**

| Slot | Type |  | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `titulo` | `rich-text` | required | text; at most 80 characters |
| `subtitulo` | `rich-text` | optional | text; at most 140 characters |
| `imagem` | `image` | optional | a path to an image |
| `tom` | `enum` | optional | one of `azul`, `laranja`, `verde` (default `azul`) |
